g.text: End-to-End Technical Flowchart • Smart India Hackathon 2026 • Team DevAlly
Level-1 Sentinel-1 SAR IW GRD Swath
ESA Copernicus C-Band (5.405 GHz) • 10m Ground Sample Distance GeoTIFF
• Decibel (dB) radiometric calibration & dynamic min-max scaling
NVIDIA CUDA FP16 Acceleration • 0.826 IoU Benchmark
Generates 3-Class Softmax Probability Maps: [0: Sea, 1: Mineral Oil, 2: Lookalike]
Suppresses natural algal blooms, biogenic films, and low-wind calm zones
Distance-weighted Gaussian blending merges overlapping patch probabilities
• OpenCV cv2.findContours converts raster masks into WGS-84 MultiPolygons
• Computes geometric centroid (Lat₀, Lon₀) and metric surface area (km²)
Applies standard appearance thickness codes (1–5) to estimate volume in m³
CMEMS Global Ocean Physics & NOAA GFS Wind Ingest
Hourly surface currents (u, v) + 10m atmospheric wind velocity fields
Reverse Numerical Integration (-Δt) to Spill Origin
• Hydrodynamic drift velocity: u_net = u_current + 0.03·u_wind + Stokes drift
• Steps backward in time: T0 observation ➔ T - 6.5h estimated release time
• Pinpoints release coordinates (Lat_origin, Lon_origin) at T - 6.5h
• Computes dynamic spatial uncertainty radius R(t) = σ_pos + k·t
Models forward dispersion plume for environmental shoreline threat warning
Dark Target Cross-Match (SAR Radar vs AIS Transponders)
Extracts CFAR radar ship signatures and cross-references active AIS positions
NOAA MarineCadastre AIS Historical Vessel Stream
MMSI, vessel dimensions, coordinates, SOG, COG, true heading
Queries bounding box [Locus ± 0.35°] within window [T_origin - 2h, T_origin + 2h]
Haversine Great-Circle Distance & Time Delta Calculation
• Computes Closest Point of Approach (CPA) distance to reconstructed origin
• Evaluates temporal delta (Δt), speed anomalies, and course deviations
• Replaces abstract math scores with transparent kinematic evidence
• Ranks candidate vessels and compiles audited track intersection history
PHASE 5: TACTICAL C2, DISPATCH & LEGAL EVIDENCE DOSSIER
NGA World Port Index Response Routing
Calculates nearest salvage base, geodesic intercept vector, and containment ETA
Tactical C2 Tri-Pane Interface & Replay Simulator
Next.js 14 + Leaflet GIS: Real-time slick contours, range rings, and 4-step replay
• Sentinel-1 geodetic provenance, U-Net masks, and IoU validation metrics
• RK4 drift trajectory logs, suspect vessel registry, and SHA-256 custody hash
Dispatches real-time alerts to Indian Coast Guard (ICG) Ops & DG Shipping
